limitations: Disposable browser context and random loopback origin in an OS network namespace. All water is fabricated; not a real diary or account.
Exact archived +14 HTML, JS, worker and bootstrap, with observation-only IDB put tracing and accessibility enabled. Only one selected scheduling sequence was tested.
Three separate +250 clicks are treated as separate intentions. Identical snapshots show loss of that intention in this scenario, not a proof about all possible histories.
Socket cut is not physical airplane mode, power loss, quota exhaustion, Safari/iOS, Android, multi-device, Auth, cloud sync or actual backup/restore.
No patch to +14 or new client was tested. No claim about all journal types, bfcache, rollback design, or readiness to release.
